findings.repair: Entire exchange replaced by non-mailing commemorative impression consultation: purpose, no addressee, requested date versus actual date, preview position against own drawing, conditional refusal and return. No claim that real facility offers service.

findings.reason: Ceramic internal movement requires void filling with own cushioning, seal after checking, preserve one-item contents. Poster tube requires buying tape, securing end caps and placing address on tube body; completed packaging accepted for weighing. Closure stages differ.

Outer-versus-gift packaging and internal cushioning differ, but both describe incomplete packaging, prepare material, arrange item, distinguish contents/roles, then return for measurement. Moriya additionally changes from retaining bag around clothes to folding it separately without explicit explanation. Must resolve before final approval.
